name: M3M Capital Walk
summary: The project, developer (M3M India), Sector 113 Dwarka Expressway location, commercial type, under-construction status and four retail levels are confirmed. Our RERA number is the correct Phase-1 registration, but Phase 2 has its own number (GGM/612/344/2022/87), which most portals cite. Land area (18.95 vs 12 / 7.71 / 2 acres) and starting price (₹53 L-₹1.25 Cr, one at ₹6.54 Cr) vary widely between sources. We publish no possession date, though sources give Dec 2025-2028.

checks.web: ₹75 Lakh onwards (Propzilla); ₹1.20 Cr (m3mindian); ₹1.25 Cr (other listing); ₹53.34 L for 373 sq ft (cityspaceindia); ₹2.5 Cr (megarealtymax); ₹6.54 Cr (RealtyAssistant listing)
checks.note: Sources disagree widely and none states ₹1 Cr. The closest figures (₹75 L, ₹1.20 Cr) are each 20-25% away. Our value sits inside the range of sources but has no exact support.

checks.web: 18.95 acres / 876 units (portal search summary); 12 acres (ananthamgroup); 7.71 acres (m3mindian, riseinfraventures); 2 acres (Propzilla)
checks.note: Sources conflict. Search summaries support 18.95 acres, but I couldn't open that page (m3mdevelopments.com returned 404), and several sites give 7.71 acres. The 18.95 figure may cover a larger M3M Capital land parcel than Capital Walk alone.

checks.web: Four retail levels (Lower Ground, Ground, 1st, 2nd); ~876 units per one summary
checks.note: Floors (4 levels) match. We don't publish a unit count.
